critical_code_review_comments: LoginTeaserVideo.tryAutoplayWithSound calls el.play() twice on failure — the retry after re-muting is fine, but if the browser also blocks muted autoplay (extremely rare) the promise rejection is swallowed silently; consider logging to help future debugging.
No aria-pressed on the login-teaser-sound button to indicate mute state programmatically — only aria-label toggles. Adding aria-pressed=true/false would improve a11y/testability.
handleEnded resets currentTime=0 and calls play() but does not guard against the video being detached; benign but could throw during route transition.
